title: Inherited constructible triangles and exact ambient scalar extension
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, let $X$ be a scheme with Noetherian underlying space, and let $E$ be a finite intermediate field $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq\Omega$. Use $E_X=p_X^*C(-,E)$ with its restricted norm topology and $\Omega_X=p_X^*\underline\Omega$, where $\underline\Omega(S)$ consists of continuous functions valued in one finite intermediate field [def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]. Let $\mathcal C_E=D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,E)$ be the full subcategory of $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{E_X})$ with bounded stratified locally finitely presented cohomology, and let $\iota_E$ be its full inclusion [def-sfb-dcons-subfield, sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible].

The category $\mathcal C_E$ has the inherited pretriangulated structure, its integer shift functors are additive, and $\iota_E$ is triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For the coefficient inclusion $E_X\to\Omega_X$ [def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map], the ordinary scalar-extension functor $F_E=\Omega_X\otimes_{E_X}-$ between the abelian internal module categories is additive and preserves finite limits and finite colimits [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. Its derived extension $T_{E,\Omega}=LF_E$ [def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar] is canonically identified with $D(F_E)$, the functor applying $F_E$ termwise to a representing complex [def-sfb-left-derived-exact]. With the integer-shift comparison transported through this canonical identification, $T_{E,\Omega}$ is triangulated. In particular $T_{E,\Omega}\iota_E$ is triangulated and is canonically identified, compatibly with shifts, with the restriction of exact termwise scalar extension. No triangulated structure on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Omega)$ is required.

proof.text: Apply the finite-field theorem isConstructibleModuleObject_serre_padicSubfield of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-constructible-serre] at X and E. Its coefficient object and constructibility predicate are already exactly padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ E and IsConstructibleModuleObject; no separate presentation-identification transport is needed. Transport the kernel and cokernel conclusions along limit.isoLimitCone and colimit.isoColimitCocone, using IsConstructibleModuleObject.of_iso, to obtain the ObjectProperty kernel and cokernel closure classes. Its extension clause gives the extension closure class directly. Apply isTriangulated_boundedConstructible_of_serre of [prop-weil-pbc-module-bounded-constructible-triangulated], which proves zero and isomorphism closure from presentations and invokes the generic weak Serre homology-property argument. This proves the first assertion without using the disputed arbitrary-ring noetherian-only instance.

The full triangulated subcategory construction [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory] now supplies additive integer shifts and its triangulated inclusion for the same boundedConstructible predicate. These structures are inherited from the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

Use the existing additive extension-of-scalars instance and its left-adjoint finite-colimit preservation [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]; apply the exact coefficient inclusion instance [lem-sfb-qlbar-flat] for finite limits. The abelian sheaf and module structures are the recorded instances [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed, lem-sfb-modobj-abelian]. This is precisely the recorded coefficient map, with no changed scalar-extension construction.

Keep constructibleScalarExactComparison unchanged: its body is the existing counit-normalized leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory for this exact ordinary scalar extension, identifying [def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar] with its termwise mapDerivedCategory. The latter functor is triangulated by the Mathlib exact-derived-functor instance [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. This existing comparison avoids reconstructing a universal-property argument between complexes and homotopy categories.

The recorded condensedAlgClCoefficientCommShift [def-weil-pbc-condensed-coefficient-comparisons] is definitionally CommShift.ofIso of the inverse of that same canonical comparison. Apply Mathlib Functor.CommShift.ofIso_compatibility to that inverse, then NatTrans.CommShift.of_iso_inv to obtain compatibility of the forward comparison. Functor.isTriangulated_of_iso applied to the inverse comparison transfers triangulatedness from the exact termwise functor to derivedExtendScalarsToPadicAlgCl. Its proof uses the canonical image-triangle isomorphism and invariance of distinguished triangles [def-weil-triangulated-category].

Compose the inherited triangulated inclusion with the derived extension to obtain triangulatedness of the restriction. The instance for whiskering a shift-compatible natural transformation on the left gives compatibility of isoWhiskerLeft of the same comparison with every integer shift. Assemble the ten conclusions. All image triangles remain in the ambient closure-coefficient derived category.
